title: Full Filter Cycle Consistency
description: Change every filter on the Reporting page multiple times in a row — range, group-by, timezone — and prove the stat tiles, both charts, and the data table always move together as one consistent picture, never caught mid-update showing a mismatched mix of old and new.
successCondition: Across four consecutive filter changes (e.g. widen the date range, switch groupBy to Month, switch timeZone to a different zone, then narrow the date range again), after each "Update" click and once loading settles, the StatTile totals, both bar charts' bars, and the data table rows are cross-checked against each other for internal consistency (StatTiles equal the sum of the currently-shown buckets, chart bars match table rows) — for all four states, not just the final one.
hints: Snapshot and check consistency after each of the four updates individually, rather than only checking the state after the last one — an intermediate stale-render bug could otherwise slip through.
Give each Update click's request time to resolve before capturing that step's snapshot, especially if Practice mode's slow network toggle is also on.
